story.title: A ball thrown at an angle

scenes.heading: Where does it land?
sentences: You kick a ball into the air at an angle.
How far away does it land?

scenes.heading: The path of the ball
sentences: The ball leaves the ground at 20 metres per second, 30 degrees above the ground.
Its path is a curve called a parabola.
It stays in the air for 2.04 seconds and lands 35.3 metres away.
At the top of its path it is 5.10 metres high.

scenes.heading: A steeper throw
sentences: Now throw it at 45 degrees with the same speed.
It stays up longer, for 2.89 seconds, and lands 40.8 metres away.
On level ground, 45 degrees gives the longest range.

scenes.heading: What decides the range
sentences: The range comes from the speed, the angle and gravity.
Without air resistance, 30 degrees and 60 degrees land in the same place.
